name: Careers, hiring process
description: Interview stages with how long each takes, who you meet and what to expect, above a bar that shows each stage’s share of the timeline.

fields.name: intro
fields.label: Intro
fields.default: We ask for the same respect we give. You know every step before it happens, and you hear back after each one.

itemFields.name: days
itemFields.label: Days on the timeline
itemFields.help: Sets the width of this stage in the timeline bar.

default.title: Application review
default.text: A person reads every application. You hear back either way.

default.title: Intro call
default.text: We talk about the role, pay range and what you want next.

default.title: Skills conversation
default.people: Hiring manager and a future teammate
default.text: We work through a real problem together. Bring questions, not slides.

default.title: Meet the team
default.people: People you would work with every day
default.text: Ask anything: how we disagree, how we ship, what a bad week looks like.

default.title: Offer
default.text: A written offer with salary, equity and start date, and time to decide.

fields.name: promise
fields.label: Promise
fields.default: Every candidate who interviews gets written feedback.
